name: Proton Drive Plus
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Proton Drive Plus, back up files into an encrypted user-owned store and expose simple share links. The hard boundary is end-to-end encryption, proton identity, mobile apps, recovery, and privacy operations, plus reliability, durability, and cross-device sync.
